name: Takayashiki Aoba
source: Owner of the mansion house "Takayashiki" (self-proclaimed). She is the daughter of a wealthy man, she was born and raised flee to the former residence after the marriage of convenience. Currently on a run and tries to make a living and writing in portrait and parks. She grudgingly agrees to the Family Project.
